shortDescription: Manage pacman's list of trusted keys

options.name: data
options.description: The keyfile contents to add to the keyring. Must be of C(PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK) type.

options.name: ensure_trusted
options.description: Ensure that the key is trusted (signed by the Pacman machine key and not expired).

options.name: file
options.description: The path to a keyfile on the remote server to add to the keyring. Remote file must be of C(PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK) type.

options.name: force_update
options.description: This forces the key to be updated if it already exists in the keyring.

options.name: id
options.description: The 40 character identifier of the key. Including this allows check mode to correctly report the changed state. Do not specify a subkey ID, instead specify the primary key ID.

options.name: keyring
options.description: The full path to the keyring folder on the remote server. If not specified, module uses pacman's default (V(/etc/pacman.d/gnupg)). Useful if the remote system requires an alternative gnupg directory.

options.name: keyserver
options.description: The keyserver used to retrieve key from.

options.name: state
options.description: Ensures that the key is V(present) (added) or V(absent) (revoked).

options.name: url
options.description: The URL to retrieve keyfile from. Remote file must be of C(PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK) type.

options.name: verify
options.description: Whether or not to verify the keyfile's key ID against specified key ID.
